_note: The campaign, in order. Each level changes data for its match with "set" (dotted paths, as the batch runner's --set). "win_award_money" is paid into the starting money of both sides in the next level, so it doesn't tip the balance. "intro" names a line in data/dialogue.json said at the start of setup; "first_base_lost" one said when the player loses their first base.
